title.narrative: Providing critical WASH services and Multi-Purpose Cash to people affected by Tropical Cyclone Trami

description.narrative: The project focuses on addressing the urgent water, sanitation, hygiene (WASH) needs and economic vulnerabilities of 14,850 individuals in communities severely affected by Typhoon Kristine in the provinces of Albay and Camarines Sur, with priority municipalities including Libon in Albay and Baao, Bombon, Bula, Camaligan, Gainza, Magarao, and Milaor in Camarines Sur. These areas experienced widespread flooding, resulting in significant damage to infrastructure and exacerbating the living conditions of vulnerable populations. Key activities include:1. Emergency WASH ResponseWater Supply Restoration: Distribute water kits, repair and treat community water systems, and monitor water quality.Sanitation Support: Set up emergency toilets in evacuation centers, repair damaged sanitation facilities, establish fecal sludge treatment sites, and implement solid waste management systems.Hygiene Promotion: Provide hygiene kits, cleaning materials, and PPE; conduct hygiene promotion sessions in affected areas.Facility Repair: Repair water supply and sanitation systems, including handwashing facilities, in schools, healthcare centers, and child development centers.Capacity Building: Conduct training on WASH in Emergencies (WiE), sanitation standards (PhATSS), and contingency planning to strengthen local disaster response mechanisms and community resilience.Support WASH Cluster coordination and information management2. Multipurpose Cash Assistance (MPCA):The assistance will target 709 households in Bombon and Canaman, Camarines Sur enrolled in the government’s Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps) with young children, providing them with the financial support needed to help address basic needs, such as food, shelter, and health.
